scientific_question: Does the SUCCESS adapter selectively score successful trajectories while losing likelihood on unseen BASE trajectories?
hypothesis: The small teacher-forced gain is concentrated on the supervision distribution; cross-arm scoring will reveal a state-distribution or first-divergence mismatch rather than parser-only collapse.

controls.validity_filter: H1 reconciliation valid episodes only; preserve invalid source files and record their exclusion

primary_metrics: token-normalized mean log-probability by model arm and source arm
paired SUCCESS-minus-BASE delta on each source trajectory

stop_branch.selective_success_score: diagnose state-distribution or supervision-support mismatch before any optimizer change
stop_branch.uniform_score_gain: consider a new closed-loop recovery protocol with the same frozen adapter
stop_branch.no_score_gain: audit trainer/objective/projection and retain H1 negative evidence
stop_branch.invalid_source_or_runtime: exclude from metrics, preserve evidence, repair runtime without changing the protocol

gpu_policy: one UUID-bound teacher-forced process per GPU; wave 2 starts only after a wave 1 GPU is idle

tracking.full_traces: local source artifacts; W&B compact summaries

claim_boundary: This is an off-policy trace diagnostic; it cannot establish closed-loop reward improvement.
